description: The two-post field format: the analyst posts the geolocation (a title line and a coordinate pair on its own line, plus an annotation photo), then replies to themselves with the footage link and nothing else. The reply is the post an entry is pointed at, so acquisition brings the same author's parent in and the thread head is the parent: the coordinate comes from the parent's text, the source from the reply's link, and provenance anchors on the parent. The linked status belongs to a third party and is served by no fixture body, so the chase 404s and the source stays link-only. Hand-built rather than recorded from a live post: replace it with a recording when one is captured.
title: Strike on the warehouse yard

archive.skip: Live two-post shape: the reply parent ships as its own syndication body, which the export assembly does not carry. The archive's own two-post shape is self_thread, and the stitch that rebuilds it is what this entry reads.
